model-value.desc: Model of the component; use v-model directive

icon.desc: Icon name following Quasar convention; if array, each rating value uses corresponding icon

icon-selected.desc: Icon name to use when selected

icon-half.desc: Icon name to use for half selection

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette; if array, each value uses corresponding color

color-half.desc: Color name for half selected icons

size.desc: Size in CSS units or standard size name (xs|sm|md|lg|xl)

no-dimming.desc: Does not lower opacity for unselected icons

no-reset.desc: Disables resetting model to 0 when clicking current value

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model
